headline: Stonecradle Rekindles as Fishermans Row Consolidates Under One Flag
war_summary: Since our last edition Fishermans Row has settled under a single flag, all nine of its works now Colonial after a day of thirty-nine changes about Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia, the latest logged in mid-afternoon. Stonecradle, quiet at our previous press, has roared back: more than twelve thousand casualties in a day, hourly counts topping a thousand on each side, and the line moved to six Warden against three Colonial. Mooring County remains the freshest front, logging flag changes inside the final hour and a toll above sixteen thousand, with Wiccwalk its busiest post. Weathered Expanse, in a rare lull, has posted no new flag events in some three hours, yet its twenty-four-hour butcher's bill nears twenty-nine thousand. Stlican Shelf and the Linn of Mercy both changed flags within two hours of this edition, the Linn's Warden losses now past three thousand a day, while Marban Hollow's Mox post alone saw ten events. The ledger stands at 292 works Colonial to 144 Warden, and not a single base lies in ruin. Day 266; no victor declared.
